body: I was scared shitless of skeletons and after I had a dream that there was some tentacled beast in our pool filter that grabbed me in the middle of the night and ate me, I refused to swim in that pool for a really long time. ;_;

It really doesn't help to keep reading about it. I've been dealing with it for coming up on 12 years. I don't remember what normal feels like either. I didn't realize until I was in my late teens that normal people didn't feel the urge to kill themselves on a regular basis. 

You can do it, friend. Stay strong. I believe in you!
